jobs.title: Freelance Auditor Food
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a food-industry technical auditor role requiring a food technology degree, 5+ years in food production, and 3rd-party audit qualifications (IFS/BRC). Multiple hard ineligibilities: 5+ years required, specific vocational certifications, and Dutch language required for the work.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor
jobs.reason: Social compliance auditing is outside the candidate's target zones and requires specialist auditor certifications (APSCA CSCA, SA8000, RBA, BSCI) plus 3–4 years of audit experience and 200+ verifiable audit days, none of which the candidate has. The role also expects a degree in Law, HR, or OHS rather than IR.

jobs.title: Trainer and Consultant
jobs.reason: This role requires specialist technical expertise in Pressure Equipment Directive (PED), ASME, ISO welding standards, and industrial training delivery — none of which the candidate has. The field (industrial compliance training) is entirely unrelated to IR, policy, or intelligence work, and the role is pitched at experienced consultants/management experts.

jobs.title: BI Analyst Developer
jobs.reason: This is a Power BI / Azure developer role in a corporate analytics team, with no connection to IR, policy, intelligence, or OSINT research. The candidate lacks the required Power BI, DAX, SQL, and Azure DevOps expertise, and the role requires 3+ years of dedicated BI development experience.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.reason: This is a B2B sales role focused on revenue growth, account management, and bid development in the assurance/inspection sector — pure sales, with no connection to the candidate's policy, IR, or research targets. The role also requires a demonstrated track record of hitting sales targets and managing strategic accounts, which the candidate lacks.

jobs.title: Formadores y auditores en Seguridad Alimentaria España
jobs.reason: Mismatch on field — this is food safety auditing and training for retail/hospitality, entirely unrelated to IR, policy, or intelligence work. The role also requires fluent Spanish, which the candidate does not speak (hard ineligibility on language), plus demonstrable auditing/training experience in the food sector.
jobs.location: Canaries & Balearics, Spain (also Valencia, Madrid, País Vasco, Málaga)

jobs.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.reason: This is a specialist cloud infrastructure engineering role requiring 3+ years Azure experience and 6+ years infrastructure engineering experience as hard requirements — triggering hard ineligibility on years of experience. The technical stack (Terraform, Kubernetes, Azure, AD) is entirely outside the candidate's research/policy profile.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor / Senior Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a social compliance auditing role requiring APSCA CSCA and BSCI Lead Auditor certifications plus 3-5+ years of auditing experience — none of which the candidate holds. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch; the role is based in China and likely requires Mandarin for on-site audits.

jobs.title: Lead Assessor / Senior Assessor
jobs.reason: This is a social compliance auditing role requiring APSCA CSCA and BSCI Lead Auditor certifications plus 3–5+ years of auditing experience — none of which the candidate holds. The role is also based in Shenzhen and likely requires Mandarin for local labour law audits. Multiple hard ineligibility triggers (specialist certifications, experience requirement).

jobs.title: Planning Advisor
jobs.reason: This is a customer service / audit planning role in commercial assurance, unrelated to IR, policy, intelligence, or research. The field mismatch is severe — pure client coordination and invoicing work with no analytical or policy substance.
